import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data
# -----------------------------
items = [
    ("Alpha",   45),
    ("Beta",    41),
    ("Gamma",   45),
    ("Delta",   31),
    ("Epsilon", 40),
    ("Zeta",    65),
    ("Eta",     40),
    ("Theta",   35),
    ("Iota",    57),
    ("Kappa",   68),
    ("Lambda",  36),
    ("Mu",      69),
    ("Nu",      70),
    ("Xi",      59),
    ("Omicron", 39),
    ("Pi",      69),
    ("Rho",     68),
    ("Sigma",   32)
]

capacity = 100          # kg, max load per pallet
max_pallets = 18        # upper bound on number of pallets (cannot exceed number of items)

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Pallet_Planning", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[(i,p)] = 1 if item i is placed on pallet p
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, p) for i in range(len(items)) for p in range(max_pallets)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary"
)

# y[p] = 1 if pallet p is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (p for p in range(max_pallets)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary"
)

# -----------------------------
# Objective: minimize number of pallets used
# -----------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[p] for p in range(max_pallets)), "Minimize_used_pallets"

# -----------------------------
# Constraints
# -----------------------------

# 1) Each item must be assigned to exactly one pallet
for i in range(len(items)):
    model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, p)] for p in range(max_pallets)) == 1, f"AssignItem_{i}"

# 2) Capacity constraint for each pallet
for p in range(max_pallets):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(items[i][1] * x[(i, p)] for i in range(len(items)))
        <= capacity * y[p]
    ), f"Capacity_{p}"

# 3) Linking constraint: a pallet is used if any item is placed on it
for i in range(len(items)):
    for p in range(max_pallets):
        model += x[(i, p)] <= y[p], f"Link_{i}_{p}"

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Solver status: {status}")

if status == "Optimal":
    used_pallets = [p for p in range(max_pallets) if pulp.value(y[p]) > 0.5]
    print(f"Number of pallets used: {len(used_pallets)}")
    print("\nAssignment of items to pallets:")
    for i, (name, mass) in enumerate(items):
        assigned_pallet = next(p for p in range(max_pallets) if pulp.value(x[(i, p)]) > 0.5)
        print(f"  Item {name:8s} (mass {mass:2d} kg) -> Pallet {assigned_pallet}")
else:
    print("No optimal solution found.")

import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data
# -----------------------------
T = 15                     # weeks
I0 = 69                    # initial inventory
q_min = 19                 # minimum order size
q_max = 57                 # maximum order size
L = 3                      # lead time (weeks)
d = {
    1: 22, 2: 20, 3: 35, 4: 13, 5: 60,
    6: 59, 7: 31, 8: 58, 9: 53, 10: 43,
    11: 22, 12: 56, 13: 30, 14: 21, 15: 43
}
C_order = 2                # cost per unit ordered
C_hold  = 3                # holding cost per unit from week t to t+1
C_short = 15               # penalty per unit of unmet demand
S_max = 69                 # storage capacity

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("procurement_and_stock_plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
q = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("q", (t for t in range(1, T+1)), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
s = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("s", (t for t in range(0, T+1)), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("u", (t for t in range(1, T+1)), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
r = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("r", (t for t in range(1, T+1)), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')

# -----------------------------
# Objective
# -----------------------------
# Holding cost is incurred on inventory carried from week t to t+1,
# i.e., on s[t] for t = 0 .. T-1
holding_cost = pulp.lpSum(s[t] for t in range(0, T)) * C_hold
order_cost   = pulp.lpSum(q[t] for t in range(1, T+1)) * C_order
shortage_cost = pulp.lpSum(u[t] for t in range(1, T+1)) * C_short

model += holding_cost + order_cost + shortage_cost, "Total_Cost"

# -----------------------------
# Constraints
# -----------------------------

# Initial inventory
model += s[0] == I0, "Initial_Inventory"

# Order bounds
for t in range(1, T+1):
    model += q[t] >= q_min, f"Order_Min_{t}"
    model += q[t] <= q_max, f"Order_Max_{t}"

# Arrival definition
for t in range(1, T+1):
    if t <= L:
        model += r[t] == 0, f"Arrival_Zero_{t}"
    else:
        model += r[t] == q[t - L], f"Arrival_Link_{t}"

# Inventory balance
for t in range(1, T+1):
    model += (
        s[t] == s[t-1] + r[t] - d[t] + u[t],
        f"Inventory_Balance_{t}"
    )

# Storage capacity
for t in range(0, T+1):
    model += s[t] <= S_max, f"Storage_Capacity_Upper_{t}"
    # lower bound already enforced by variable definition (lowBound=0)

# Shortage limits
for t in range(1, T+1):
    model += u[t] <= d[t], f"Shortage_Upper_{t}"
    # lower bound already enforced by variable definition (lowBound=0)

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total Cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}\n")

print("Week | Order q[t] | Arrival r[t] | EndInv s[t] | Shortage u[t]")
print("--------------------------------------------------------------")
for t in range(1, T+1):
    print(f"{t:4d} | {q[t].varValue:10.2f} | {r[t].varValue:11.2f} | {s[t].varValue:10.2f} | {u[t].varValue:11.2f}")

print("\nInitial inventory s[0]:", s[0].varValue)

import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data
# -----------------------------
# Routes, each as ordered list of (center, duration)
routes = {
    "R1": [("C2", 3), ("C3", 5), ("C4", 1), ("C1", 1)],
    "R2": [("C1", 6), ("C4", 10), ("C2", 1), ("C3", 10)],
    "R3": [("C4", 6), ("C3", 9), ("C2", 3), ("C1", 4)],
    "R4": [("C4", 3), ("C3", 3), ("C2", 5), ("C1", 6)],
}

# Create a flat list of all tasks
tasks = []          # (task_id, route, index, center, duration)
for r, seq in routes.items():
    for idx, (c, d) in enumerate(seq):
        task_id = f"{r}_{idx+1}"
        tasks.append((task_id, r, idx+1, c, d))

# Helper dictionaries
duration = {t[0]: t[4] for t in tasks}
center_of = {t[0]: t[3] for t in tasks}
route_of = {t[0]: t[1] for t in tasks}
order_in_route = {t[0]: t[2] for t in tasks}

# Big‑M (larger than any possible makespan)
M = 100

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("logistics_schedule", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: start time of each task (continuous, >=0)
start = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("start", duration.keys(), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan variable
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Cmax", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Objective: minimise makespan
model += Cmax

# -----------------------------
# 1) Completion time constraints (Cmax >= each task's finish)
# -----------------------------
for t in duration:
    model += start[t] + duration[t] <= Cmax, f"makespan_{t}"

# -----------------------------
# 2) Precedence constraints within each route
# -----------------------------
for r, seq in routes.items():
    for i in range(len(seq) - 1):
        t_curr = f"{r}_{i+1}"
        t_next = f"{r}_{i+2}"
        model += start[t_curr] + duration[t_curr] <= start[t_next], f"prec_{t_curr}_before_{t_next}"

# -----------------------------
# 3) Resource (center) capacity constraints
#    No two tasks that use the same center may overlap.
#    Linearised with binary variables.
# -----------------------------
# Gather tasks per center
tasks_by_center = {}
for t in duration:
    c = center_of[t]
    tasks_by_center.setdefault(c, []).append(t)

# Binary variables: y_{i,j}=1 if i precedes j on the same center
y = {}
for c, tlist in tasks_by_center.items():
    for i in range(len(tlist)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(tlist)):
            ti = tlist[i]
            tj = tlist[j]
            var_name = f"y_{ti}_{tj}"
            y[(ti, tj)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")
            # i before j
            model += start[ti] + duration[ti] <= start[tj] + M * (1 - y[(ti, tj)]), f"center_{c}_{ti}_before_{tj}"
            # j before i
            model += start[tj] + duration[tj] <= start[ti] + M * y[(ti, tj)], f"center_{c}_{tj}_before_{ti}"

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (total completion time): {pulp.value(Cmax)}\n")
print("Start times for each handling stage:")
for t in sorted(duration.keys()):
    print(f"  {t} (Center {center_of[t]}, Duration {duration[t]}): start = {pulp.value(start[t])}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Optimization model for selecting conservation practices on agricultural fields
to achieve a required reduction in nutrient runoff at minimum cost.

The model follows the specification:
- Binary decision variables x[f,p] indicate whether practice p is applied on field f.
- Baseline runoff = Σ_f (runoff_coeff[f] * area[f]).
- Effective reduction on a field is assumed additive:
      reduction_factor_f = Σ_p (reduction[p] * x[f,p])   (capped at 1)
- Runoff after mitigation = Σ_f (runoff_coeff[f] * area[f] * (1 - reduction_factor_f)).
- The total runoff after mitigation must be ≤ (1‑P) * baseline runoff.
- Total cost = Σ_f Σ_p (cost_per_area[f][p] * area[f] * x[f,p]) is minimized.
"""

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fields (indexed 0..8)
area = [
    145.063,  # Field 1
    186.821,  # Field 2
    168.599,  # Field 3
    88.282,   # Field 4
    223.798,  # Field 5
    207.578,  # Field 6
    125.279,  # Field 7
    215.416,  # Field 8
    215.621   # Field 9
]

runoff_coeff = [
    1.139,  # Field 1
    1.837,  # Field 2
    0.621,  # Field 3
    2.987,  # Field 4
    2.155,  # Field 5
    2.134,  # Field 6
    0.549,  # Field 7
    2.224,  # Field 8
    1.542   # Field 9
]

# Practices (indexed 0..8)
reduction = [
    0.68,  # Practice1
    0.42,  # Practice2
    0.79,  # Practice3
    0.24,  # Practice4
    0.82,  # Practice5
    0.32,  # Practice6
    0.81,  # Practice7
    0.81,  # Practice8
    0.82   # Practice9
]

cost_per_area = [
    [47.743, 47.952, 59.969, 109.398, 48.318, 143.653, 66.117, 17.487, 104.307],
    [49.462, 187.294, 72.815, 10.52, 137.61, 182.307, 168.694, 137.114, 38.337],
    [27.116, 107.224, 147.477, 29.245, 58.619, 53.92, 197.847, 66.244, 98.213],
    [28.964, 43.193, 17.494, 65.208, 162.303, 69.414, 150.323, 28.05, 154.059],
    [18.719, 171.88, 136.037, 42.397, 77.93, 93.166, 128.143, 176.91, 27.661],
    [164.843, 44.745, 86.148, 192.839, 61.648, 83.286, 171.628, 161.981, 133.281],
    [161.413, 31.481, 142.272, 21.143, 189.069, 40.285, 89.045, 122.243, 162.43],
    [138.895, 44.44, 82.153, 78.134, 15.475, 140.048, 169.322, 194.954, 34.825],
    [184.876, 31.458, 88.144, 18.735, 59.706, 69.705, 143.868, 138.806, 155.83]
]

P = 0.488  # required proportion of baseline runoff to be reduced

num_fields = len(area)
num_practices = len(reduction)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Nutrient_Runoff_Reduction", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x[f,p] ∈ {0,1}
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((f, p) for f in range(num_fields) for p in range(num_practices)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total implementation cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(
    cost_per_area[f][p] * area[f] * x[(f, p)]
    for f in range(num_fields)
    for p in range(num_practices)
)
model += total_cost, "Total_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline runoff (constant, used in a constraint)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_runoff = sum(runoff_coeff[f] * area[f] for f in range(num_fields))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) For each field, the combined reduction cannot exceed 100%
for f in range(num_fields):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(reduction[p] * x[(f, p)] for p in range(num_practices)) <= 1.0,
        f"ReductionCap_Field_{f+1}",
    )

# 2) Total runoff after mitigation must be ≤ (1‑P) * baseline
runoff_after = pulp.lpSum(
    runoff_coeff[f]
    * area[f]
    * (1 - pulp.lpSum(reduction[p] * x[(f, p)] for p in range(num_practices)))
    for f in range(num_fields)
)
model += (
    runoff_after <= (1 - P) * baseline_runoff,
    "Runoff_Reduction_Requirement",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output results
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print(f"Baseline runoff: {baseline_runoff:.4f}")
print(f"Runoff after mitigation: {pulp.value(runoff_after):.4f}")
print(f"Total cost: {pulp.value(total_cost):.2f}\n")

print("Selected practices per field:")
for f in range(num_fields):
    selected = [p + 1 for p in range(num_practices) if pulp.value(x[(f, p)]) > 0.5]
    if selected:
        print(f"  Field {f+1}: Practices {selected}")
    else:
        print(f"  Field {f+1}: No practice selected")
